0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000010_ALPHINAUD
0.description: Every day, more and more people regain their memories of their lost loved ones. No longer will beings like Calyx be able to manipulate their fear and ignorance as he once did.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: That being the case, Alisaie and I have come to a decision.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000030_ALISAIE
2.description: We will depart Tural in the coming days. Other nations must be informed about Alexandria─a necessary step to ensure lasting peace.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000040_ALISAIE
3.description: Then, we shall return to Garlemald. Our experiences here should serve us well in the ongoing restoration efforts.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000046_ALPHINAUD
5.description: Calyx's summoning ritual was tied to a <hex:021A020203>concept<hex:021A020103> of his own creation. Ascian involvement is assured, but we have yet to ascertain the extent of their influence on the Ninth.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000050_YSHTOLA
6.description: I have done what I can to treat the enthralled and those still afflicted with levin sickness, and may now devote my undivided attention to an investigation.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000051_ALPHINAUD
7.description: Then we shall leave this one in your capable hands. Do let us know if you turn anything up.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000070_ERENVILLE
8.description: (-Erenville-)It's Erenville. My time in Tural is at an end, and so I'm headed to the harbor now.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000080_ERENVILLE
9.description: (-Erenville-)We'll meet again─of that I'm certain. Until then, I wish you safe travels.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
12.description: You could have let me know in time to see you off...

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000090_ERENVILLE
13.description: (-Erenville-)Words of caution from you of all people...

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000100_ERENVILLE
14.description: (-Erenville-)And pull you away from more important business? Perish the thought...

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000110_ERENVILLE
15.description: (-Erenville-)Wh─ Hey! What do you think you're doing!?

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000120_WUKLAMAT
16.description: (-Wuk Lamat-)Sorry to interrupt, but I thought you'd like to know I've detained the fugitive.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000130_WUKLAMAT
17.description: (-Wuk Lamat-)He promises to tell us before he sets sail, only to try and sneak aboard his boat with nary a hug good-bye! Cold bastard. But there's still time before they weigh anchor!

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000140_KRILE
18.description: That boy... We should make for the harbor ere he wriggles free of Lamaty'i's grasp.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000150_ALPHINAUD
19.description: If we're heading the same way, we might join him on the ship. Good company is always welcome on a long voyage, is it not?

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000160_ALISAIE
20.description: What, now!? I haven't finished packing!

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000170_ALPHINAUD
21.description: Knowing you, the essentials are already accounted for.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000190_ALISAIE
23.description: Fine, if we must... But you're helping pack the rest.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000200_ALISAIE
24.description: And I hope you've decided on a souvenir for Jullus.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000210_ALPHINAUD
25.description: I have several ideas, as it happens...

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000220_YSHTOLA
26.description: Ever aligned in purpose...if not execution.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000230_GRAHATIA
27.description: Lest you wonder, Krile and I intend to remain here with Y'shtola.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000231_YSHTOLA
28.description: To continue our study of the key, naturally. By all accounts, Preservation's facility promises to yield some answers.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000240_KRILE
29.description: Shale has been conducting a more thorough examination. She may have insights to share.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000250_ORIGINALSPHENE
30.description: Then why not invite her along to see everyone off? Surely she'd want to be there too.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000270_ALISAIE
32.description: You look well. No lingering effects, then?

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000280_WUKLAMAT
33.description: Eh, I'm hale as ever! And busy with work...

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000290_ALPHINAUD
34.description: I imagine there's no shortage of affairs to put in order. Are Koana and Gulool Ja faring well?

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000300_WUKLAMAT
35.description: Koana is off to survey our nation and its peoples. He wants to consult with local representatives and hear their thoughts on our policies.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000310_WUKLAMAT
36.description: And Gulool Ja's really taken to his training! I feel like he's been spending more time with the Landsguard than me lately.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000320_ALPHINAUD
37.description: Standing here, I cannot help but remember the day of our arrival in Tuliyollal. The rite of succession feels so long ago...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000330_WUKLAMAT
38.description: We knew naught of what would happen between my father and Zoraal Ja, nor of Alexandria and its queen...

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000340_WUKLAMAT
39.description: It was to aid a naive claimant that you came to Tural. But you've done so much more for me...

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000350_WUKLAMAT
40.description: For the entire nation of Tuliyollal. We owe you a greater debt than we can ever repay.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000360_WUKLAMAT
41.description: ...But that doesn't mean we can't try! Whenever you need an ally, we'll stand with you.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000370_ORIGINALSPHENE
42.description: Allow me to echo that sentiment.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000380_ORIGINALSPHENE
43.description: Not only were you kind to me when I awakened a stranger in my own land, you extended your grace to Alexandria again and again.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000390_ORIGINALSPHENE
44.description: And, on behalf of myself and my people...

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000391_ORIGINALSPHENE
45.description: Thank you for curing the ailment that for centuries tormented us.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000392_ALISAIE
46.description: I'll look forward to our next visit. I'm sure we'll have exciting stories to share with one another.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000400_ERENVILLE
47.description: Ever since I introduced you to Wuk Lamat, you've faced no end of hardships. Many of them her fault.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000410_ERENVILLE
48.description: Yet I feel no remorse...only gratitude. For without your aid, I would not have had the chance to say good-bye.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000420_ERENVILLE
49.description: Nor vowed to explore every corner of the world...

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000450_ALPHINAUD
52.description: Rest assured, upon arriving we shall make it a priority to visit Tataru and assuage her myriad fears.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000460_YSHTOLA
53.description: I expect the sight of you two will be a balm for her worry-laden heart.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000470_SHALE
54.description: Safe journey! And remember to enjoy it.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000480_ERENVILLE
55.description: Give my regards to Oblivion. ...And thank you, for all you did for my mother.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000510_WUKLAMAT
58.description: That was a proper send-off! Now─time to get back to it.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000520_ORIGINALSPHENE
59.description: Duty ever calls for she who loves her realm.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000530_WUKLAMAT
60.description: Right? Though if you need a break, you're always welcome to visit Tuliyollal. I'll give you the grand tour!

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000540_WUKLAMAT
61.description: I...I guess they're really over. Your adventures in Tural.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000550_WUKLAMAT
62.description: I'll remember our time together for the rest of my days.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000552_GIRL05426
64.description: The Landsguard is looking for you! It's sparring time!

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000554_WUKLAMAT
65.description: Oh! Good thing you're here, then. Can't miss that!

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000555_BOY05426
66.description: So let's go already! Everyone's waiting to see the Vow of Resolve in action!

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000580_GRAHATIA
69.description: And thus do they take to the winds.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000590_KRILE
70.description: To follow their own paths, and their hearts... As they should.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000610_SHALE
72.description: An endless ocean and ever-changing sky...

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000620_SHALE
73.description: First time I saw them, I couldn't believe my eyes. It was like I was walking among images from our oldest records.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000630_SHALE
74.description: And beyond that horizon are more lands and more people... Heh. That one, I still struggle to imagine.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000640_KRILE
75.description: We ourselves hail from “beyond that horizon,” in fact.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000650_KRILE
76.description: ...Rather, most of us do. I merely thought I did.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000660_ORIGINALSPHENE
77.description: Oh, that's right... I can only imagine how it must've felt to learn you're a native of our world.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000670_KRILE
78.description: The fact that I wasn't born in the land where I've spent most of my life has...taken time to sink in.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000680_KRILE
79.description: 'Twas not until I met my parents in Living Memory that the truth of my origin began to feel real.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000690_ORIGINALSPHENE
80.description: Your experience is not unlike mine. When first I awoke, the realm everyone spoke of sounded nothing like my own. I had to walk its streets─live and breathe it─before I could accept and embrace my new reality.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000700_KRILE
81.description: And for me to embrace mine, I need to learn more about my people, the Milalla.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000710_KRILE
82.description: We should come upon more information in the course of studying the key, but as Shale's investigation of the containment complex is still ongoing...

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000711_KRILE
83.description: Would you mind if we sought a different avenue of inquiry into the history of the Ninth?

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000712_GRAHATIA
84.description: I have no objection. Aught we learn will deepen our understanding of the broader picture.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000720_YSHTOLA
85.description: Agreed. My curiosity extends well beyond our duty to assess Ascian influence.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000730_ORIGINALSPHENE
86.description: If it is knowledge of the Ninth's past you seek, I have an idea where to begin.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000740_ORIGINALSPHENE
87.description: Alexandria was originally part of a landmass known as the Mist Continent.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000750_ORIGINALSPHENE
88.description: This continent had been left in ruins in the wake of the Storm Surge, with Alexandria the sole nation to survive the devastation.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000760_KRILE
89.description: The calamity of lightning that ravaged the world...

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000770_GRAHATIA
90.description: Aye. Per the sources we recovered from the Underkeep, though the conflict between nations was destructive in its own right, 'twas levin that dealt the final blow.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000780_ORIGINALSPHENE
91.description: No place was spared its fury, and all was chaos in the castle town. We tried to evacuate the people in airships─Otis, the knights, and I─but we couldn't save everyone...

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000790_ORIGINALSPHENE
92.description: Those who survived gathered within the barrier, and we took in as many foreign refugees as we could...

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000800_ORIGINALSPHENE
93.description: Yet despite the dangerous environment, our systems showed that there were some few souls who ventured outside the barrier into the lands beyond.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000805_KRILE
94.description: Beyond!? But we thought that was impossible!

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000806_KRILE
95.description: I was under the impression the star was scoured of life─that man could not survive outside the barrier...

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000807_SHALE
96.description: Going by the records, the Storm Surge extended to every corner of the world. Nothing and nowhere was spared.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000808_SHALE
97.description: If anyone did survive out there, it would have been an unimaginable trial.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000810_ORIGINALSPHENE
98.description: And yet, those people must have been going somewhere... What if there was a refuge─a place that weathered the Storm Surge, and rebuilt over the intervening four centuries?

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000815_YSHTOLA
99.description: Given Alexandria's displacement to the Source, we had neither cause nor opportunity to survey the remainder of the continent.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000820_KRILE
100.description: Living Memory remains physically in the Ninth...

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000830_KRILE
101.description: If we seek a means of egress other than the portal connecting it to Alexandria, perhaps it might lead us to the Mist Continent.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000840_ORIGINALSPHENE
102.description: Living Memory was not transported here despite being “atop” Everkeep. In which case, it may have been a physically independent space all along.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000850_GRAHATIA
103.description: Meaning another point of egress could well exist.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000860_SHALE
104.description: And if it does, someone has to be maintaining it. The mechanical soldiers, for instance.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000870_ORIGINALSPHENE
105.description: Shall we have a chat with them and see what they know?

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000890_KRILE
107.description: Will you accompany us? If we do land upon the Mist Continent, I would feel much more assured with you at our side...

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
109.description: I wouldn't miss it for two worlds.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
110.description: I would hate to see you obliterated by some lightning-beast...

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
111.description: Anything for you. Just say the word!

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000900_KRILE
112.description: I thought as much! Into the great unknown we go, then.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000910_KRILE
113.description: As would I. Let us make every effort to ensure none of us suffer such a dreadful fate.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_000920_KRILE
114.description: Well, thank you kindly! I look forward to another adventure at your side.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001030_LUMULL
115.description: (-Exuberant Voice-)And the perimeter is clear! Good work, everyone!

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001040_LUMULL
116.description: (-Exuberant Voice-)And a big “thank you” to our helpers─whoever you are!

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001050_LUMULL
117.description: (-Exuberant Voice-)Now, we have a tiny bit of clearing up ahead of us. You know what to do!

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001062_YSHTOLA
119.description: So the city endures. And it is in much better shape than expected.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001064_GRAHATIA
121.description: The people here must have gone to great lengths to maintain all of this.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001065_ORIGINALSPHENE
122.description: Their barrier resembles that of Alexandria, though it is smaller in scale.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001066_ORIGINALSPHENE
123.description: And not quite as effective, if the breach we witnessed is any indication. I fear such incidents may be common here.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001070_MIAYLI
124.description: (-???-)Thunderous heavens! It's been years since we've had visitors!

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001080_MIAYLI
125.description: I am Miayli, the mayor of Treno. Allow me to welcome you to our city! And thank you for the assistance with our little monster problem just now.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001090_MIAYLI
126.description: Might I ask your name, miss? Though I have an inkling I know it already...

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001100_ORIGINALSPHENE
127.description: But of course. I am Sphene, of Alexandria.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001110_MIAYLI
128.description: As I thought. It truly beggars belief...

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001120_MIAYLI
129.description: I once heard the strangest of reports from one of ours who went to Alexandria, you see. That despite the intervening years, the queen had not aged a day.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001130_MIAYLI
130.description: And sure enough, I'd swear you'd stepped out of an old oil portrait mere moments ago! You must forgive me if this takes some getting used to.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001140_MIAYLI
131.description: It is an honor to meet you, Your Majesty. I look forward to hearing the tale from your own lips.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001150_MIAYLI
132.description: I imagine it won't be an easy one to tell. But please...

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001170_ORIGINALSPHENE
134.description: I see... From your perspective, it must have looked as though we were wiped from the face of the star.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001180_MIAYLI
135.description: One day, we lost all contact with our people in Alexandria.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001190_MIAYLI
136.description: A scouting party sent to investigate reported that not only the barrier, but Alexandria itself was gone. Nary a stone to mark where it had stood...

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001200_ORIGINALSPHENE
137.description: What you must have gone through, not knowing what became of us...

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001210_ORIGINALSPHENE
138.description: But know that Alexandria yet survives, albeit in a distant land. Her <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> her people.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001220_ORIGINALSPHENE
139.description: I can tell you the whole tale from beginning to end. But first, might I ask your permission to remain in Treno for a time?

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001230_MIAYLI
140.description: Of course you can! You and your companions have already done us a great service, and are more than welcome to enjoy our hospitality.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001240_MIAYLI
141.description: Now, how about we continue this at town hall? We needn't keep standing in the middle of the street.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001250_YSHTOLA
142.description: I shall join them. Even with the precautions we've taken, it remains to be seen if Sphene's condition will remain stable.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001260_YSHTOLA
143.description: I suspect, however, that the rest of you would rather be out and about. Consider this my blessing.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001270_GRAHATIA
144.description: In light of our purpose here, a tour of the city is indeed in order.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001280_KRILE
145.description: I presume you have no objection?

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001290_KRILE
146.description: With your permission, then. Ah, but before we go...

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001300_KRILE
147.description: Allow me to introduce myself as well. I am Krile, and I hope to learn more of this city and its people.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001310_KRILE
148.description: Would it offend if we were to ask a few questions? Perhaps as we work alongside you, aiding you in whatever ways you may require?

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001320_MIAYLI
149.description: You needn't fret─Treno folk are as friendly as they come. As for aid...

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001330_MIAYLI
150.description: If you're willing, you might speak with my grandson, Lumull─that was his voice you heard earlier. You'll find him serving herbal remedies to the others.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001340_KRILE
151.description: Thank you for your guidance! We shall seek him out first.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001350_LUMULL
152.description: Well, what do you think? It's a traditional Milalla recipe!

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001370_LUMULL
158.description: Hahahaha! Got that right! Don't worry─the tingling means it's working.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001380_LUMULL
159.description: No need to pretend─I'm not that thin-skinned. Just do your best to keep it down!

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001390_KRILE
160.description: I'm put in mind of the gelatin I had at the Studium... “Nutritious,” they assured me...

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001395_GRAHATIA
161.description: I can relate all too well...

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001400_GRAHATIA
162.description: It's not unlike the syrup Lyna used to make. Black as pitch, and sour as sin... Though there's no better cure for fatigue.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001410_KRILE
163.description: You know, Raha... Going to bed at a reasonable hour would be the best cure.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001420_KRILE
164.description: Oh! That's...hm. I do feel shockingly refreshed.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001430_GRAHATIA
165.description: Perhaps it stimulates the body's ability to process aether and hastens regenerative functions?

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001440_LUMULL
166.description: Indeed it does! It also counteracts some of the effects of excess lightning, and helps to calm the nerves besides.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001450_KRILE
167.description: ...Which is why you serve it whenever there's a breach in the barrier.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001460_LUMULL
168.description: Our Milalla ancestors came from the lushest of lands, so they developed all sorts of natural remedies. We strive to carry on their traditions.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001470_LUMULL
169.description: ...And I'm sure you see why! Really hits the spot, doesn't it?

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001490_KRILE
171.description: Fascinating. I appreciate your thoroughness in recounting the details.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001500_KRILE
172.description: I too learned much, as I helped to treat the injured's wounds.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001510_KRILE
173.description: The Milalla's curative magicks appear identical to Sphene's. This means that either her tutor was a Milalla as well, or that the art had spread all throughout the Ninth.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001520_KRILE
174.description: Then there are the symbols and tomes, which are highly reminiscent of arcanima. If these elements indeed originated with the arcane geometries of the south sea isles, as in the Source, 'tis curious that they have developed in so similar a manner on this shard.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001530_GRAHATIA
175.description: Mind you don't share that with any other graduates of the Faculty of the Arcane, lest they beat you to publication.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001540_KRILE
176.description: Did you learn aught of note, Raha?

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001550_GRAHATIA
177.description: I spoke with one of Treno's storekeepers about how they obtain their supplies.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001551_GRAHATIA
178.description: Though they are few and far between, other settlements yet exist on the Mist Continent, with a rail system facilitating the flow of goods between them.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001560_GRAHATIA
179.description: Unfortunately, barrier breaches trigger an emergency failsafe on the main line, so the train is presently stopped at a midway point until operations can resume.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001570_GRAHATIA
180.description: There are also maritime routes, but they see only occasional use. Often, as now, Treno must make do with what is to hand.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001580_KRILE
181.description: In addition to this constant state of scarcity, much of Treno's populace suffers from levin sickness─not to mention the frequent attacks on the city and the resulting casualties.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001590_KRILE
182.description: Yet everyone we've spoken with seems undaunted by these hardships. They are not only surviving─they are happy, in spite of it all.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001595_GRAHATIA
183.description: Where there is life, there is hope.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001596_GRAHATIA
184.description: And when one believes in a better future─a tomorrow even the slightest bit brighter than today─there is naught to be done but build it.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001597_GRAHATIA
185.description: Until, stone by stone, a city rises.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001600_KRILE
186.description: A noble city, with noble purpose.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001620_LUMULL
188.description: I think I've dropped something and now I can't find it anywhere. I...I'm doomed.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001630_KRILE
189.description: Oh! Is it this, by chance?

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001650_KRILE
190.description: While I was distributing the remedy, I was asked to pass it along to you.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001660_LUMULL
191.description: Yeees! That's it! Yes! I'm not doomed.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001680_LUMULL
193.description: You've a keen eye for technology! This thing picks up on the aether of the creatures that get through the barrier.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001690_GRAHATIA
194.description: That explains how you knew when they'd been vanquished.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001700_LUMULL
195.description: Exactly! It shouldn't show anything now, but I can switch it on like so...

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001710_LUMULL
196.description: Nooo! No! Nonono! She's going to kill me!

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001720_LUMULL
197.description: Uh... Say, how'd you like to meet my sister Eyaney? She's an electrope engineer, so she knows all sorts of interesting stuff...

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001730_KRILE
198.description: I take it she also built that device?

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001740_LUMULL
199.description: Oh, yes. That's my sister! She's a genius, everyone says so.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001750_LUMULL
200.description: And she won't kill me in front of other people. Probably.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001751_LUMULL
201.description: I mean, wouldn't it be interesting to watch her work? Maybe you can even help! It'd be, you know...edifying?

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001780_EYANEY
204.description: Ah, our visitors! Thanks for lending a hand earlier, but...what brings you here?

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001782_LUMULL
206.description: I-I, um... You know that, er, advanced monster tracking wotsit? I-It may be a teeny tiny bit, um...

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001788_EYANEY
208.description: How many times must I tell you that we're running low on electrope! I'm an engineer, not a bloody miracle worker!

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001784_LUMULL
209.description: I beg your forgiveness! I'm on my knees and everything, see!?

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001785_LUMULL
210.description: And since we have guests...can't you let it slide? Just this once?

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001787_EYANEY
212.description: He dragged you here just so I wouldn't tan his hide, didn't he? You'd never believe he's the elder sibling... I'm so sorry.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001790_KRILE
213.description: Please don't be. We're glad for the opportunity to meet you. And Lumull mentioned that you might have some work we could assist with?

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001800_EYANEY
214.description: They're our guests, Lumull, not servants! Must we have the manners talk again?

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001810_KRILE
215.description: Please don't misunderstand! We asked to help, that we might learn what life is like in Treno.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001820_KRILE
216.description: And with your expertise, we also hoped you could tell us more of how the city utilizes electrope.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001830_EYANEY
217.description: If that's the way of it, then I'd be happy to share what I know.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001840_GRAHATIA
218.description: When you spoke earlier, it sounded as if Treno had little electrope to spare. It's difficult to procure, I take it?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001850_EYANEY
219.description: We never have as much as we need. And much of what we do have is repurposed─you'll find me digging through the scrap heap whenever some vital device or another breaks down.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001860_EYANEY
220.description: Repairing that old barrier should be our highest priority, but we just don't have enough electrope on hand to do a proper job.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001870_LUMULL
221.description: And the longer we go without access to the mine, the worse it'll get. If only we could scare those beasts away...

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001875_KRILE
222.description: Did we not pass through a mine on the way here?

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
224.description: Indeed, and it should be clear of hazards now.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
225.description: Aye, and took care of the beasts in one fell swoop.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001880_LUMULL
226.description: You got rid of them? Just like that!?

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001900_EYANEY
228.description: So...the mine is safe for mining again?

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001910_LUMULL
231.description: Leave the mining to your big brother! All you have to do is fix the tracker!

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001920_EYANEY
232.description: Yes, very well... If you go, do be careful.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001930_EYANEY
233.description: And once you get the machinery up and running, make sure to send some electrope over to the barrier service station!

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001940_GRAHATIA
234.description: Though we've cleared the mine, there is no telling what else waits outside the barrier. Shall I accompany you?

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001950_LUMULL
235.description: I'm so glad you asked! ...Seriously, I don't know what I'd do if I'd had to go alone.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001960_KRILE
236.description: As we did pass through but recently, I expect Raha can keep him safe without our help. In the meantime, shall we assist Eyaney with her repair work?

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001970_KRILE
237.description: Ah, were you looking for me?

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001980_KRILE
238.description: I only intended to sit down for a moment, but I must have lost track of time...

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_001990_KRILE
239.description: Will you lend me your ear?

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002010_KRILE
241.description: Someday, I will have to decide which one to call home.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002020_KRILE
242.description: The thought has lingered like a storm cloud in my mind...

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002030_KRILE
243.description: I've tried to ignore it. Remind myself that we have more important matters to contend with. But I cannot keep drifting between these worlds forever.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002050_KRILE
245.description: When I first learned the truth of my past, I assumed it would have no bearing on my future. The Source was my home, and the Students of Baldesion my purpose.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002070_KRILE
247.description: It struck me that to simply choose the Source would be to abandon them. And not only them, but a home I could have loved, had my life gone as it should have...

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002080_KRILE
248.description: That is why I had to learn more of this place─and the “me” I could have been.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002090_KRILE
252.description: I feel even less certain than before.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002100_KRILE
253.description: But the more I learn, the less certain I become.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002110_KRILE
254.description: Though we are strangers to them, these people have welcomed us as if we are their own. It's like speaking with old friends.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002111_KRILE
255.description: And knowing now the challenges they face, what would it say about me if I just left them behind and returned to the Source?

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002120_KRILE
256.description: Is that who I am─who I was meant to be? Or is this where I belong...?

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002130_KRILE
257.description: That reminds me─the structures near the barrier all seem to be designed for Milalla. Is there a reason that those in the center of the city are so much larger?

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002140_EYANEY
258.description: Oh, yes! The center is the oldest part of Treno, built by the Hyune and the Eldite before the Milalla came.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002150_KRILE
259.description: So Treno predates the Milalla's arrival?

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002160_EYANEY
260.description: The mayor at the time was kind enough to take our ancestors in, and gave them leave to establish their own residential quarter.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002170_KRILE
261.description: Yet I have seen naught but Milalla since we came to the city. Where did the other peoples go?

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002180_EYANEY
262.description: Alexandria. In the closing days of the Storm Surge, when death and destruction were everywhere, they believed it would be safer. Treno didn't have a barrier at first, you see.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002190_EYANEY
263.description: But one of our industrious brethren had served as tutor in the royal household, and returned to us with knowledge of the barrier's design. It's thanks to him that the city survives to this day.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002200_KRILE
264.description: Might I ask a more personal question?

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002201_KRILE
265.description: We previously uncovered some records pertaining to the Milalla's past.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002202_KRILE
266.description: In them, it was written that the Milalla left their “paradise of eternal summer” when “a great calamity froze their isles.”

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002203_KRILE
267.description: Understandably, all were not content to leave their homeland behind.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002204_KRILE
268.description: Some attempted to return using the same power that had brought them here, but they found the way closed to them.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002205_KRILE
269.description: “Never again has the golden path opened that allowed their ancestors to flee to safety.”

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002210_KRILE
270.description: Tell me─were that golden path to open once more, and you were to find the Milalla homeland restored to its former glory...

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002230_EYANEY
272.description: I'd certainly like to see that “paradise of eternal summer” for myself! Who wouldn't?

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002240_EYANEY
273.description: But it wouldn't be “going back.” After all, my one and only home is here.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002250_EYANEY
274.description: Treno! This run-down, beat-up, beautiful city.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002260_KRILE
275.description: You truly love it, don't you?

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002270_EYANEY
276.description: Do you know what the Speaker said, when the Milalla came to this place?

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002280_EYANEY
277.description: O life, flourish on this faraway shore,<hex:02100103>Unfurl your fragile petals with fearless joy.<hex:02100103>Let this sky grant shelter from darkest storm,<hex:02100103>And here bloom, hand in hand, forevermore.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002290_EYANEY
278.description: We never forgot those words. Not my ancestors, nor my grandmother, nor my brother and me.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002300_EYANEY
279.description: That boundless optimism, that communal spirit─that is Treno. No matter what comes or how hard it gets, we'll choose joy over fear and stand together. There's nowhere else I'd rather be.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002310_KRILE
280.description: Nowhere else you'd rather be... Perhaps it really is as simple as listening to your heart.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002320_LUMULL
281.description: We're back! The mine is in working order, I'm pleased to say.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002330_LUMULL
282.description: Electrope is being delivered for the barrier even as we speak!

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002340_GRAHATIA
283.description: Have you two finished regaling the mayor?

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002350_YSHTOLA
285.description: Though she has her own story to tell─of the key, in fact. We thought you might like to join us at the─

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002360_TRAINSYSTEM
286.description: (-Railway Monitoring System-)This is an evacuation alert.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002370_TRAINSYSTEM
287.description: (-Railway Monitoring System-)All citizens, please proceed to emergency shelters. Repeat: please proceed to emergency shelters.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002371_TRAINSYSTEM
288.description: (-Railway Monitoring System-)The Doomtrain is approaching. Repeat: please proceed to emergency shelters.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002380_ORIGINALSPHENE
289.description: The Doomtrain? Wasn't that one of Lindblum's weapons of war?

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002400_ORIGINALSPHENE
291.description: I've never seen it myself, but according to Zelenia, it was an armored vehicle used to transport war-beasts to the front.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002410_ORIGINALSPHENE
292.description: In order to prevent them from running wild ere their deployment, a powerful arcane entity was housed in the engine.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002420_EYANEY
293.description: The end of the war didn't slow it one bit. Quite the contrary. Fueled by lightning aether, it's been speeding across the continent ever since.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002430_EYANEY
294.description: The Doomtrain and its beasts bring death and destruction everywhere it goes. It's a veritable calamity on rails.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002440_EYANEY
295.description: It passed near Treno some years ago, claiming many lives. Including our parents'...

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002450_EYANEY
296.description: I must go and repair the barrier as swiftly as possible. Without it, we haven't got a chance.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002460_LUMULL
297.description: You can't be serious! You'll never finish in time─and you'll be right in its path!

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002470_EYANEY
298.description: I have to try. For Treno.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002490_GRAHATIA
300.description: It seems my services are required once more.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002500_ORIGINALSPHENE
301.description: I'll go with you. Perhaps my knowledge of electrope will be of use.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002510_LUMULL
302.description: I wish I were a fighter like you two. Keep her safe, will you? Please...

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002520_YSHTOLA
303.description: While destroying the Doomtrain would be preferable, we should seek to delay its advance at the very least.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002530_LUMULL
304.description: You can't be thinking of fighting it head-on! That's madness!

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
306.description: Trust me, we can handle this.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A6_000_003_NONE_VOICE
308.description: Well, now I <hex:021A020203>have<hex:021A020103> to do it.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002540_LUMULL
309.description: If your mind is made up...there may be a way.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002541_LUMULL
310.description: There's a freight depot not far from us. We can use the train that's stopped there.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002550_KRILE
311.description: Raha mentioned that before, did he not?

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002560_LUMULL
312.description: The Doomtrain will have to pass through the depot to reach Treno. And since the evacuation alert was only just triggered, we might be able to reach it first.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002570_YSHTOLA
313.description: So we commandeer this freight train, match our speed to the enemy's, and use it as a platform from which we launch a sustained counteroffensive. Is that your proposal?

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002580_LUMULL
314.description: It'd be better than trying to smash the bloody thing before it runs us all over.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002590_LUMULL
315.description: And if it might save Eyaney...I'll do whatever it takes.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002600_LUMULL
316.description: Let me drive the train. That will leave you free to concentrate on the fight.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002620_LUMULL
318.description: I need to grab a few things. Meet me by the gate.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002640_LUMULL
320.description: You'll be riding that flatcar at the rear of the train.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002641_LUMULL
321.description: I'll be all the way at the front, pushing her as fast as she can go.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002650_LUMULL
322.description: The Doomtrain moves at breakneck speed. If we're too slow, it'll plow right through us.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002660_LUMULL
323.description: Speaking of which, we'd best get underway before it does just that...

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002670_LUMULL
324.description: Don't forget you're fighting for Eyaney. For all of Treno.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002680_LUMULL
325.description: Here it comes! Brace for impact!

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002691_LUMULL
327.description: No more adventures, thank you. That was enough bravery for a lifetime.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002700_LUMULL
328.description: But we did it! We stopped the Doomtrain! Well, mostly you did.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002710_LUMULL
329.description: Before we can celebrate, though, we need to make sure Treno's secure.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002720_LUMULL
330.description: As I feared. Stray beasts to the south.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002730_LUMULL
331.description: I've lost track of how many times I've asked you for help, but...I need your help again.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002790_RESIDENTTREA
337.description: There were others being attacked over by the canal. Could you possibly...?

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002800_KRILE
338.description: Of course, I'll go right away. The rest of you should get to the town hall.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002810_KRILE
339.description: I can't leave anyone behind. I won't!

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002890_GRAHATIA
347.description: Eyaney has finished the repairs. We need only hold the line until the barrier is in place.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002900_KRILE
348.description: And hold the line we will, together!

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002920_GRAHATIA
350.description: I must say, that was an incredible performance.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
352.description: Remind me never to stand in your way...

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002950_YSHTOLA
356.description: The barrier is restored. The people of Treno may rest easy once more.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002960_LUMULL
357.description: (-Lumull-)The perimeter is clear, everyone! And thanks to our guests, the Doomtrain has been destroyed!

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002970_LUMULL
358.description: (-Lumull-)Last but not least, Eyaney's fixed the barrier. We don't need to worry about beasts anymore!

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_002990_RESIDENTTREB
360.description: The Doomtrain is gone for good!?

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003030_MIAYLI
364.description: Krile, does the name “Alayla” mean aught to you?

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003040_KRILE
365.description: My mother? Did you... Did you know her?

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003060_MIAYLI
367.description: I'm sorry, my dear. We should get you patched up before aught else.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003070_MIAYLI
368.description: Alayla's story and that of the key are one and the same. After you've rested and recovered, I'll tell you the tale.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003080_MIAYLI
369.description: You have no cause to fret, I promise you.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003090_MIAYLI
370.description: While Lumull forgot to give the order─bless him─there's work to be done ere we can celebrate.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003091_MIAYLI
371.description: First and foremost, we must see to any injured.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003100_MIAYLI
372.description: Come and find me at town hall when you're ready.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003110_KRILE
374.description: You needn't mind me. My injuries are far from severe.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003130_YSHTOLA
376.description: But your curiosity is another matter, is it not? Your feet will deliver you to Miayli all the swifter if you can actually walk on them.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003140_MIAYLI
378.description: Ere I begin my tale, there is something about our family that you need to understand.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003150_MIAYLI
379.description: We are descendants of the Speakers of eld, and I myself am the latest to inherit the role.

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003160_MIAYLI
380.description: Even as we do our utmost to ensure our people's welfare in our adopted home, it has ever been our duty to find a means to return whence we came.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003170_MIAYLI
381.description: Alas, our ancestral treasure never did answer our prayers. And that left my elder sister, the previous Speaker, mired in doubt.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003180_MIAYLI
382.description: It was then, when she was at her most vulnerable, that Preservation reached out to her.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003190_ALAYLA
383.description: (-Alayla-)The key is none other than that relic, and it has been in the safekeeping of our people since time immemorial.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003200_ROBOR
384.description: (-Robor-)Yes. When lightning threatened this world, we attempted to use the key to flee again like our ancestors once did.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003210_ROBOR
385.description: (-Robor-)Alas, no matter what we tried, we couldn't invoke its power. We had all but given up when Preservation approached us with an offer of partnership.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003220_KRILE
386.description: We've heard this part before. From my parents' memories...

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003240_MIAYLI
388.description: She was. Which makes you an heir to the Speaker's legacy.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003250_MIAYLI
389.description: The last message I received from your parents said that, in order to thwart Preservation's design, they must send away both their daughter and the key.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003260_MIAYLI
390.description: I now understand what became of the former. As for the latter...through conversing with your friends, I gleaned with whom it currently resides.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003270_KRILE
391.description: And...is it your wish that we give it back?

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003280_MIAYLI
392.description: We Milalla are the people of Treno, now. Here is where we've put down our roots.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003290_MIAYLI
393.description: The moment Alayla relinquished the key, she relinquished our claim to it as well.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003291_MIAYLI
394.description: But be that as it may, my sister gave up not only her life, but her darling daughter to prevent its misuse.

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003300_MIAYLI
395.description: It is my duty to ensure that its new bearer is worthy. So...

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003310_MIAYLI
396.description: Should it answer your call as it never did ours, how would you use the key's power?

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A8_000_001_NONE_VOICE
398.description: To explore worlds yet unknown to us.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
399.description: To save lives, and perform other such feats of heroism.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003320_MIAYLI
401.description: For some, that might be a self-serving end. But your deeds are proof that I needn't worry.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003330_MIAYLI
402.description: The very fact that you don't have an answer is proof that you understand the weight of this power, and do not take it lightly.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003340_MIAYLI
403.description: And what's more, there's your friendship with my niece. I daresay that speaks well of your character.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003350_YSHTOLA
404.description: By the by, do you have any records pertaining to the key here in Treno?

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003360_MIAYLI
405.description: Would that we did, but Alayla took everything with her when she joined Preservation. If aught remains, it would be in Alexandria.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003370_YSHTOLA
406.description: And so we find ourselves returned to our original course...

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003380_KRILE
407.description: Shale may have made some progress. Perhaps it's time to bring our visit to an end.

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003400_KRILE
409.description: B-By that, I don't mean to say that I don't feel welcome in Treno... You've all been so kind and accommodating, and in many ways it's my hometown! I-It's just that...well...

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003411_MIAYLI
411.description: It is true that some feel bound by blood or birthplace... But I don't believe that your parents would have wanted that for you.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003420_MIAYLI
412.description: They devoted their lives to understanding the key so that future generations would not be burdened by it.

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003430_MIAYLI
413.description: As we have chosen Treno, so too should you choose the place you call home. A place where you can bloom and grow with fearless joy.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003450_MIAYLI
415.description: We must give you a proper send-off, though. Wait for us by the gate, will you?

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003460_MIAYLI
416.description: A word of caution, keeper of the key.

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003470_MIAYLI
417.description: As you know, it is a relic that has traveled across centuries and worlds, passing through countless hands...

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003480_MIAYLI
418.description: ...Oft beckoning to those ruled by ambition or avarice. Indeed, some have wondered if it chooses its master.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003490_MIAYLI
419.description: But I believe differently. I believe that some inexorable force─call it “fate” if you will─ushers it from one bearer to the next.

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003500_MIAYLI
420.description: Be wary, for fate's regard now falls upon you.

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003520_LUMULL
422.description: We're the ones who should be thanking you! You fought so many times for us.

423.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003530_YSHTOLA
423.description: I've tended to the people's immediate hurts, but see that they receive appropriate care as they recover.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003540_LUMULL
424.description: I still can't believe you took down the Doomtrain─just like that! You're my hero, truly. And I'm sure Mum and Dad and everyone else we lost will rest easier now that it can never hurt anyone again.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003550_EYANEY
425.description: For my part, I cannot thank you enough for supporting my plan for the barrier. Not to mention that we wouldn't even have the electrope to restore it without your aid.

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003560_EYANEY
426.description: I can't wait to see what else we can do now that the mine is back in service!

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003580_EYANEY
428.description: O life, flourish on this faraway shore,<hex:02100103>Unfurl your fragile petals with fearless joy.<hex:02100103>Let this sky grant shelter from darkest storm,<hex:02100103>And here bloom, hand in hand, forevermore.

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003590_EYANEY
429.description: Remember that, will you? Whatever shore you choose.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003600_KRILE
430.description: Of course. Those words, and our people, will always be in my heart.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003610_MIAYLI
431.description: After so long without her, I had begun to forget what my sister was like. Her face, her voice...fading like the mist. All I could remember clearly was her resolve as we parted for the last time...

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003620_MIAYLI
432.description: But now, I've seen her again. In you, sweetheart.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003630_MIAYLI
433.description: Thank you...for bringing her back to me.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003631_MIAYLI
434.description: It is a joy to have met you, Krile.

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003650_MIAYLI
436.description: I know your home lies far from here, but to us, you'll always be family.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003660_MIAYLI
437.description: Come and see us once in a while, won't you?

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003680_KRILE
439.description: My comrades have found a treatment for levin sickness, so I'll bring it to Treno as soon as I can.

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003690_MIAYLI
440.description: My, my! You certainly have no shortage of accomplished friends.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003700_MIAYLI
441.description: We'll await your return, my dear.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003710_MIAYLI
442.description: Life is full of surprises when one lives in hope. Isn't that right, Alayla?

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003810_MIAYLI
444.description: Now, there is much to be done.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003820_MIAYLI
445.description: With access to the mine restored, I'd like to explore methods to expand our food production systems. I look forward to your insights.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003840_HALMARUT
447.description: (-Frantic Woman-)I only meant to steal a glimpse while we were in the area...

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003850_HALMARUT
448.description: (-Frantic Woman-)But our eyes definitely met, didn't they? That's not ideal...

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003860_HALMARUT
449.description: (-Frantic Woman-)Such fearsome instincts, to perceive me as a threat in an instant... But I shouldn't be surprised. It's the Source's vaunted hero, after all...

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003940_CALYX
457.description: (-???-)One need hardly be the Warrior of Light to notice you. You're far from subtle.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003950_CALYX
458.description: (-???-)As if the horns and scales weren't enough, you insist upon dressing for another century. Those clothes must be as old as I am.

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003970_HALMARUT
460.description: You mean the robe that practically announces me as an Ascian?

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003980_HALMARUT
461.description: Not that I don't intend to reveal that detail, but it will be at a time of my choosing.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_003990_HALMARUT
462.description: Besides, if one of us can't help but draw the eye, it's you.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004040_HALMARUT
467.description: Jests aside, we will be departing the Ninth all too soon.

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004050_HALMARUT
468.description: If you wish to say your good-byes, I could find you a vessel and mold it to match your preferred presentation...

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004060_CALYX
469.description: Don't you dare. I will not debase myself by occupying a living body ever again.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004070_CALYX
470.description: And in any case, to travel the rift as you do requires the shedding of one's flesh, does it not?

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004080_HALMARUT
471.description: I apologize if I upset you. Your understanding is, in essence, correct.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004090_HALMARUT
472.description: The magicks cannot bring a vessel through the rift. Ergo, you must discard it and assume a form of pure aether until you reach the other side.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004100_HALMARUT
473.description: However, that doesn't mean you need discard <hex:021A020203>everything<hex:021A020103> like so much refuse.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004110_HALMARUT
474.description: Using fissures such as this, one can easily send small amounts of matter between reflections.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004130_CALYX
476.description: All the more reason to remain as I am. At present, I could pass through a fissure myself.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004140_CALYX
477.description: And as this form suffices for surveying the material realm, I see no reason to expend effort searching for a replacement.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004150_CALYX
478.description: I wish only to observe. That is enough.

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004170_HALMARUT
480.description: Nevertheless, odd though you may look, I would encourage you to bid farewell to those to whom you have attachment.

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004180_HALMARUT
481.description: For now that you've failed, unless our hero changes course...

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004200_CALYX
483.description: I had hoped to banish death from their lives.

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004210_CALYX
484.description: Why should it come to all, whether they will it or no? Why must any accept this burden and grief?

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004220_CALYX
485.description: It was never about any one person. So no, there are none with whom I would exchange fond farewells.

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004230_CALYX
486.description: But so long as mankind yet survives, I can hold fast to my faith...

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004240_CALYX
487.description: That my life's work might again bring someone salvation.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004250_HALMARUT
488.description: Hold fast you must, as we press ever onward...

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004260_HALMARUT
489.description: For soon, it begins, and every world shall tremble. The Winterers must be prepared to outlast the great withering to come.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004270_CALYX
490.description: That's your ominous prediction, is it?

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004280_HALMARUT
491.description: No, it's nature's proclamation. Can't you hear it?

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07400_004290_HALMARUT
492.description: It echoes in the silence left by the will of the star.
